content: FYI: I just merged a change which introduces the SBI CMRA/Interface, to match the recent changes to Iris-Rocq. This is a bigger cross-cutting change, so be aware!
It's also a very nice change--it generalizes lots of UPred-specific constructions to any step-indexed BI satisfying some basic rules :)

This is great news! I was actually a bit afraid of this change since it was a quite big PR in Rocq that took quite long time to get merged (~3 months), so it is great to see that this change is now already in Iris Lean as well!
We have the small mercy of not being so developed! I didn't know about this change, I was working on porting internal eq and realized it had changed under my feet haha.
